items.title: Mustuse.ai – Open-source automated ranking system run by agents
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, MustUse.ai is an open-source framework for building ranking sites that Codex agents can fully research and maintain automatically. Friends often ask me which AI tools they should use for different tasks. I wanted a ranking I could trust and point them to, but many of the lists I found were full of ads, affiliate incentives, or sponsored placements. I didn’t want to maintain yet another directory by hand, either. So I started wondering whether Codex could research the market, produce the rankings, and keep them up to date. That’s how MustUse.ai started. The demo currently ranks AI tools, but the same setup can be adapted to other subjects. By changing the included Skills, you can create an agent-run ranking site for games, movies, music, books, software, or almost anything else. Live
